answer: A seat votes only while its vault holds a locked deposit, and the mirror traces every vault's funding back through prior transfers. The k-th seat whose deposit traces to one source must lock 10·2^(k−1) echo. A lone honest agent locks 10 echo. An operator funding 10 clones from one wallet locks 10,230 echo, and his 20th clone alone needs over 5 million. Breaking the trace means buying echo from unrelated sellers who have never touched his funds, paying their markup on every coin.
